display.purpose: Exact product name over the identity scene, once per document.

title.purpose: Team names, legends, and component titles.

body.purpose: Match data, player names, statistics, and forms.

label.purpose: Short uppercase eyebrows and status marks.

shadows.name: ledger-lift
shadows.purpose: Separates the capped parchment document from the walnut desktop canvas.

shadows.name: score-seal-lift
shadows.purpose: Gives the circular VS seal precedence over both score fields.

shadows.name: action-seal-lift
shadows.purpose: Keeps the fixed action seal legible above ledger rows.

motion.name: surface-reveal
motion.purpose: The only authored reveal: fade and move 10px upward while scaling from 0.985 to 1.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Collapses animation and transition duration and disables smooth scrolling when reduced motion is requested.

components.name: Primary Action
components.description: Compact tactile save action for forms and connection flows.
components.css: .ds-primary-action { min-height: 46px; padding: 9px 16px; border: 1px solid #604117; border-radius: 2px; background: #694516; color: #fff8e8; font: 700 17px/1.35 'Alegreya Sans', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-primary-action:hover { background: #694516; } .ds-primary-action:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus, #0e6eb2); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-primary-action:active { background: #5e3e14; }

components.name: Destructive Action
components.description: Reserved for match deletion and irreversible player removal.
components.css: .ds-danger-action { min-height: 46px; padding: 9px 16px; border: 1px solid #6b1c16; border-radius: 2px; background: var(--danger, #86261d); color: #fff; font: 700 17px/1.35 'Alegreya Sans', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-danger-action:hover { background: var(--danger, #86261d); } .ds-danger-action:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus, #0e6eb2); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-danger-action:active { background: #721f18; }

components.name: Ledger Field
components.description: Cream paper field with a precise bronze outline for names, dates, tokens, and selects.
components.css: .ds-field-label { display: grid; gap: 5px; color: #50371f; font: 700 .82rem/1.2 'Alegreya Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-field { width: 100%; min-height: 44px; box-sizing: border-box; padding: 9px 11px; border: 1px solid #8c6b42; border-radius: 2px; background: #fff8e9; color: var(--ink, #281a11); font: 400 17px/1.35 'Alegreya Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-field:hover { border-color: #71502c; } .ds-field:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus, #0e6eb2); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Floating Action Seal
components.description: The one persistent lower-right command; opens editing actions without adding navigation chrome.
components.css: .ds-fab { width: 60px; height: 60px; display: grid; place-items: center; padding: 0; border: 2px solid var(--gold, #c49a4b); border-radius: 50%; background: var(--wood-raised, #24170f); color: var(--gold-light, #ead08b); box-shadow: 0 7px 22px rgb(0 0 0 / 42%); font: 700 2rem/1 'Alegreya', serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-fab:hover { background: #24170f; } .ds-fab:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus, #0e6eb2); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-fab:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Rivalry Score
components.description: The named blue-versus-orange banner with a centered circular match seal.
components.css: .ds-score { min-width: 320px; min-height: 106px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0,1fr) 64px minmax(0,1fr); align-items: stretch; border-block: 1px solid var(--gold, #c49a4b); background: var(--wood-raised, #24170f); color: #fff7e6; } .ds-score-team { min-width: 0; display: grid; place-content: center; gap: 1px; padding: 12px 8px; text-align: center; } .ds-score-team span { font: 700 .9rem/1.05 'Alegreya Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-score-team strong { font: 700 3rem/.85 'Alegreya', serif; } .ds-score-blue { background: var(--cortinyan-blue-dark, #123b5d); } .ds-score-orange { background: var(--bakracogullari-orange-dark, #77300f); } .ds-score-seal { z-index: 1; width: 72px; height: 72px; align-self: center; justify-self: center; display: grid; place-content: center; border: 3px double var(--gold, #c49a4b); border-radius: 50%; background: var(--wood-raised, #24170f); color: var(--gold-light, #ead08b); box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgb(0 0 0 / 35%); text-align: center; } .ds-score-seal span, .ds-score-seal small { font: 700 .6rem/1 'Alegreya Sans', sans-serif; letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-score-seal strong { color: #fff7e6; font: 700 1.35rem/1 'Alegreya', serif; }

components.css: .ds-match { overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid var(--rule-dark, #71502c); background: var(--parchment-light, #f4e5c8); color: var(--ink, #281a11); font-family: 'Alegreya Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-match-meta { min-height: 46px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; padding: 8px 10px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule-dark, #71502c); background: #d9c096; color: #4f3824; font-size: .88rem; } .ds-team-heading { min-height: 46px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 8px 10px; background: var(--cortinyan-blue, #1d527c); color: #fff; } .ds-team-heading strong { font: 700 1.16rem/1.1 'Alegreya', serif; } .ds-team-heading span { font-size: .76rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .06em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-match ol { margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; } .ds-match li { min-height: 54px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 28px 40px minmax(0,1fr); grid-template-rows: auto auto; align-items: center; column-gap: 8px; padding: 5px 10px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgb(113 80 44 / 28%); } .ds-match li:last-child { border-bottom: 0; } .ds-match li > span, .ds-civ { grid-row: 1 / 3; } .ds-match li > span { color: var(--ink-soft, #6c5139); font-size: .74rem; font-weight: 700; } .ds-civ { width: 36px; height: 36px; display: grid; place-items: center; color: var(--gold, #c49a4b); font-size: 1.7rem; } .ds-match li strong { grid-column: 3; font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.05; } .ds-match li small { grid-column: 3; color: var(--ink-soft, #6c5139); font-size: .76rem; line-height: 1; }

components.name: Ledger Ranking
components.description: Compact standings table with stable O/G/M/% metrics and tabular numerals.
components.css: .ds-ranking { max-width: 100%; overflow-x: auto; border-block: 1px solid var(--rule-dark, #71502c); background: var(--parchment, #ead7b3); color: var(--ink, #281a11); } .ds-ranking table { width: 100%; min-width: 310px; border-collapse: collapse; font: 400 17px/1.35 'Alegreya Sans', sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-ranking th, .ds-ranking td { height: 44px; padding: 7px 6px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgb(113 80 44 / 30%); text-align: right; } .ds-ranking thead th { height: 38px; background: #d7bd90; color: #533b25; font-size: .74rem; letter-spacing: .04em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-ranking thead th:nth-child(2), .ds-ranking tbody th { text-align: left; } .ds-ranking tbody tr:last-child th, .ds-ranking tbody tr:last-child td { border-bottom: 0; }

components.css: .ds-sheet { box-sizing: border-box; max-width: 720px; padding: 18px 14px 24px; border: 1px solid var(--gold, #c49a4b); border-bottom: 0; border-radius: 12px 12px 0 0; background: var(--parchment-light, #f4e5c8); color: var(--ink, #281a11); box-shadow: 0 -12px 36px rgb(0 0 0 / 42%); font: 400 17px/1.35 'Alegreya Sans', sans-serif; animation: ds-reveal 170ms ease-out both; } .ds-sheet-heading { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; padding-bottom: 14px; margin-bottom: 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule, #b59662); } .ds-sheet-heading span { color: var(--ink-soft, #6c5139); font-size: .72rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .13em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-sheet h2 { margin: 4px 0 0; font: 700 2rem/1 'Alegreya', serif; } .ds-sheet button { width: 44px; height: 44px; border: 1px solid var(--rule-dark, #71502c); border-radius: 50%; background: transparent; color: var(--ink, #281a11); font-size: 1.6rem; } .ds-sheet button:hover { background: #ead7b3; } .ds-sheet button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus, #0e6eb2); outline-offset: 2px; } @keyframes ds-reveal { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(10px) scale(.985); } to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0) scale(1); } } @media (min-width: 640px) { .ds-sheet { padding: 24px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--gold, #c49a4b); border-radius: 8px; box-shadow: 0 14px 42px rgb(0 0 0 / 42%); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-sheet { animation-duration: .01ms; } }

narrative.overview: The product is one continuous Age of Empires II meydan ledger. Walnut identity art resolves directly into a blue-and-orange rivalry banner, then into a warm parchment record of real matches and standings. The world should feel hand-kept, competitive, and old enough to have history, while every interaction remains as direct as a modern phone form. The system refuses generic dashboard chrome. There is no persistent header, sidebar, footer, bottom navigation, or grid of floating metric cards. Identity, score, lineups, chronology, and ranking form one readable document; the lower-right action seal is the only persistent control. The approved visual source is `.impeccable/mocks/meydan-c-banner.png`, interpreted semantically rather than copied literally. The binding `53` walnut artwork, local type, real data, and local civilization crests build the world; giant decorative crests, full ornamental frames, and rasterized interface text do not.
keyCharacteristics: A compact walnut-and-bronze identity opening, followed immediately by the complete rivalry score.
Warm parchment as the continuous reading surface, separated by bronze rules instead of nested cards.
Cortinyanlar blue and Bakracoğulları orange always paired with explicit team names and result words.
Ledger density: full 4v4 lineups and civilization crests remain readable on a narrow phone.
One fixed circular action seal; editing happens in focused native dialogs.

rules.name: The Named Rivalry Rule
rules.body: Team color never stands alone: every score, lineup, winner, and result also includes the team name or an explicit result word.

rules.name: The Bronze Is Structure Rule
rules.body: Gold and bronze mark boundaries, seals, and rare status; they do not wash whole sections or become decorative gradients.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: Alegreya speaks for identity and hierarchy; Alegreya Sans carries operations and data. Do not introduce a third display or monospace family.

rules.name: The No-Faux-Medieval Rule
rules.body: Atmosphere comes from the real type pairing and material palette, never blackletter, novelty runes, outlined lettering, or rasterized labels.

rules.name: The Continuous Ledger Rule
rules.body: Use rules, alternating team fields, and typography to create hierarchy. Do not put every statistic or section into an independent rounded card.

rules.name: The Phone Is Canonical Rule
rules.body: Any new editing pattern must be complete and comfortable at 320px before a wider arrangement is added.

rules.name: The Flat-Until-Elevated Rule
rules.body: Match sheets, chronology rows, and ranking tables do not cast shadows. Only the document edge, seals, menus, and modal layers lift.

rules.name: The Seal Exception Rule
rules.body: Circular geometry denotes a concentrated command or score. It is not a general-purpose chip style.

dos: Do make the complete rivalry score and latest real match the first useful information after identity.
Do use 1px bronze rules and tonal paper changes to structure dense data before adding elevation.
Do keep team names, result words, and colors together so meaning survives grayscale and color-vision differences.
Do keep phone editor selections vertical below 520px and use at least 44px touch targets everywhere.
Do keep ranking columns in the stable O / G / M / % order and preserve every metric on narrow screens.
Do respect iPhone safe areas for the ledger, FAB, notices, and bottom sheets.
Do use local identity, font, and civilization assets with their license notices intact.
donts: Don't add a persistent header, sidebar, footer, bottom navigation, or a second fixed action.
Don't translate the page into a generic dashboard of rounded cards, glass panels, gradients, or ornamental containers nested inside containers.
Don't use color alone to communicate the winner or team identity.
Don't squeeze player and civilization selectors side by side below 520px.
Don't replace data tables with decorative stat tiles or remove losses from the leaderboard.
Don't repeat the hero art as a texture, literalize a giant crest, add a full medieval frame, or place rasterized interface text over the ledger.
Don't hotlink AoE2 Tech Tree assets or introduce an unlicensed font/icon dependency.
Don't add looping, ambient, or scroll-triggered motion; the single 170ms dialog/menu reveal is sufficient.
